purpose: Define bounded wildfire UAS capability intents that may be proposed by the control plane but require external incident-command and aviation/operator authorization before execution.

wildfire.observe_hotspot.allowed_goal: Obtain current visual/thermal condition evidence for a suspected or active fire area.
wildfire.observe_hotspot.execution_authority: authorized incident command and UAS operator
wildfire.observe_hotspot.outcome_required: timestamped observation evidence with source/provenance and uncertainty

wildfire.map_perimeter.allowed_goal: Improve current fire-perimeter or inaccessible-area situational awareness.
wildfire.map_perimeter.execution_authority: authorized incident command and UAS operator
wildfire.map_perimeter.outcome_required: timestamped mapped observation accepted as current operational evidence by competent authority

wildfire.verify_access_edge.allowed_goal: Verify whether a ground-access edge is blocked, unsafe or passable without inferring engineering clearance.
wildfire.verify_access_edge.execution_authority: authorized incident command and UAS operator
wildfire.verify_access_edge.outcome_required: timestamped access observation; engineering/road clearance remains human-only

wildfire.request_suppression_support.allowed_goal: Request evaluation of an appropriate authorized UAS suppression-support capability for a verified unmet fire-suppression need.
wildfire.request_suppression_support.execution_authority: authorized fire incident command and qualified UAS operator
wildfire.request_suppression_support.outcome_required: verified change in fire/suppression state; mission acceptance or payload release alone is not success

hard_blocks: airspace or operator authorization not verified
platform availability or capability not verified through live operations
site-specific aviation or fire-safety review not completed
requested mission would require prohibited autonomous ignition/incendiary/hazardous-payload decision
controller_must_not_emit: altitude speed heading or drop-point command
launch land arm or payload-release command
